prospective_decision_rule.eligibility: all physical promotion gates are discharged before exposure, and a later data release supplies a joint likelihood or full covariance for same-sector C4, isotropic B0, and the complete rank-six vector
prospective_decision_rule.fail: after profiling the predeclared SO(3)/A5 orientation, the linked B0 and negative-B6 edge relation is excluded at at least five standard deviations with calibrated joint coverage
prospective_decision_rule.inconclusive: C4 is not detected, the sixth-order terms are below sensitivity, the covariance is incomplete, the carrier contribution cannot be isolated, or issue #664 supplies no source-derived positive physical lower bound on a
prospective_decision_rule.no_null_verdict: a null result cannot reject the branch unless issue #664 first provides a source-derived lower bound that places a nonzero signal inside the calibrated sensitivity domain; the premise a>0 by itself is insufficient
prospective_decision_rule.scope_of_failure: failure rejects this seam-current edge propagation branch; it rejects OPH as a whole only after a separate theorem proves the branch forced and exclusive
prospective_decision_rule.support: the zero-coefficient baseline is excluded at at least five standard deviations, the edge manifold agrees within two standard deviations, named systematics are rejected, and an independent release replicates the result
prospective_decision_rule.trigger: C4 is measured negative at at least five standard deviations with calibrated sensitivity to both linked sixth-order terms
